overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Industrials 2x Daily ETF (XLIX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund seeks daily investment results corresponding to 2x the daily performance of the State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR Fund. The fund provides leveraged exposure to U.S XLIX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
